subject.title: fix(media): make wake-false direct fallback reason-aware

question: Is the current scheduler-level test coverage plus skipped Mantis internal fixed:true artifact enough proof for this PR, or should visible/live generated-media delivery proof remain required before merge?
rationale: The code path is source-reproducible and the patch is narrowly reason-aware, but the available live artifact does not actually exercise or show the changed delivery behavior.

options.title: Require Live Delivery Proof
options.body: Keep the PR blocked until a redacted run, logs, terminal transcript, or Telegram proof stack shows an allowlisted wake-false generated-media completion direct-delivering exactly once.

options.title: Accept Scheduler Boundary Proof
options.body: Allow maintainers to merge based on focused scheduler tests and the Mantis internal fixed:true signal while explicitly owning the unproven live-channel behavior.

options.title: Use The Proof Stack First
options.body: Wait for the open proof stack to produce the baseline/candidate evidence, then return to this split implementation PR for landing.

recommendation.title: Require Live Delivery Proof
recommendation.body: Keep the PR blocked until a redacted run, logs, terminal transcript, or Telegram proof stack shows an allowlisted wake-false generated-media completion direct-delivering exactly once.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent adjacent media-delivery work and routing fixes make this the best available owner for proof-sufficiency judgment.
